entries.0c445a8a2c59fec5: A fan community platform through which creators can seek to generate revenue through article distribution, live streaming, merchandise sales and similar activities. There are no initial or monthly fixed fees; the company earns revenue on a performance-based (revenue share) basis. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.47bd099b4ff0f800: A service in which creators use “Magmag!” to publish paid newsletters and readers pay a subscription fee continuously every month. The company earns revenue by sharing subscription fees with creators, and also provides support for newsletter sales and for interaction among creators. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.47fdc1902b000bdb: The company provides paid services that support newsletter operation to creators who publish free newsletters on “Magmag!”, including a paid distribution option without inserted advertisements and a proxy registration function that registers readers on the creator’s behalf. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.5d29dd2eccdabe81: It provides advertising space set in free newsletters and official newsletters to client companies and earns placement fees.

entries.8c48b27c7ee039e5: Operates the e-mail magazine distribution platform "Magmag!" and its own Web media, connecting creators and readers.
entries.9cc1832dee597701: A reportable segment that operates the newsletter distribution platform “Magmag!” and the fan community platform “MagOne (Maguwan)”; it has been the core business since the company was founded.

entries.c49cfb7f13c3f35c: A reportable segment that operates the newsletter distribution platform “Magmag!” and the fan community platform “MagOne (Maguwan)”; it has been the core business since the company was founded. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥331 million. The live streaming service “Magmag! Live” ended its service in November 2024.
entries.c9388080ea6fba75: It operates 4 Web media: "MAG2 NEWS" for general news, "MONEY VOICE" for finance, "TRiP EDiTOR" for travel and "by them" for romance. It publishes articles edited from email newsletter content as well as newly written articles, and provides them to readers. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.ce7527ce0985ea7a: It provides advertising space set in free newsletters and official newsletters to client companies and earns placement fees. For creators of free newsletters, it also provides the “Newsletter Reader Growth Menu,” which uses advertising space to support acquiring readers. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.dfae61956fb80105: This is a reportable segment that operates Web media and sells advertising space. It operates 4 Web media, "MAG2 NEWS," "MONEY VOICE," "TRiP EDiTOR" and "by them," and also treats email newsletter content as advertising space. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 were ¥105 million.
